subject: _rom_copy_info+_bss_init_info

Relinking the dtk 1.8.3 split with mwldeppc GC/1.0, 1.1, 1.1p1, 1.2.5, 1.2.5n, 1.3, 1.3.2, 1.3.2r, 2.0 and 2.6 (-m fn_80016898) gave the same output as each other; it matches the target byte for byte once 0x80005304 is global __start. subject: game code: GC/1.3.2
evidence: Compiling bfbbdecomp/bfbb d8e8eac sources with each GC compiler (tools/compiler_probe.py, flags docs/compiler_profile/bfbb_probe.flags) and masking relocations, these target bodies occur once and only under GC/1.3.2 (mwcceppc 2.4.1 build 32, May 2002): iBoxIsectRay form at 0x8000C1FC (109 words; not 1.3, 2.0, 2.0p1, 2.6), xMat3x3RMulVec form at 0x8002E280 (25 words, FP register allocation; 1.3/1.3.2 only, no 2.x), HIPLBlockEnter 0x8002BBF4, xParGroupAddPar 0x80032610, xSGAddLoadClient 0x80038130, xSGAddSaveClient 0x80038258 (1.3 does not fold or into oris). No tested function matches only under 2.0-2.7. 1.0-1.2.5n lose most matches. GC/1.3.2r is a community patch of 1.3.2, not a release. Function names here identify the probe source, not target names.

subject: game code flags: -O4,s -inline auto,deferred -char signed
evidence: Same probe over the 72 bfbb game units matched upstream, 1.3.2, counting bodies found exactly once (>=10 words): BfBB's own flags (-O4,p, -inline off, -char unsigned) 38; -O4,s 59; plus -inline auto 74; auto,deferred 88 (adds HIPLBlockEnter 0x8002BBF4, HIPLCreate); plus -char signed 90 (adds HIPLReadString 0x8002B4D8 and xUtil_crc_update 0x80044828, loses none). -use_lmw_stmw off (on the final set) drops to 46; -O4,p on the final set gives 46. -fp_contract, -common, -str pool and -sym on change no result in this sample, so those values remain the template/BfBB defaults, not target evidence. Units may still differ; per-unit overrides need their own evidence.
